notes.title: DEVLOG #8
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41594160/1ec41be3ff45208d94a8f4253ac54d26b70faa0f.png[/img]

[h2][b]Greetings ![/b][/h2]

[h3][i]This is (hopefully) the last devlog before the game comes out.[/i][/h3]

It's about weapon upgrades for levels on the boat.


There will be 4 in total and each can be upgraded multiple times.

1. [b]Rapid-fire gun[/b]
Fires multiple rounds in a row. At maximum level one of the shots will be enhanced.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41594160/3abfdeb54f001fbd14f5b2feeb921bfb860bb9e9.gif[/img]

2. [b]Paired Pistols[/b]
Fires two powerful projectiles at once.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41594160/c16187f83ead2b3ba659cd5cfbe12b994d743d54.gif[/img]

3. [b]Blunderbuss[/b]
Fires multiple projectiles. More shells are fired as you upgrade.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41594160/be85204ebdb1da850e0cfeae27ed9ed8aeb693f7.gif[/img]

4. [b]Parrot Cage[/b]
Fires a homing mechanical parrot that flies at the nearest enemy. With upgrade, an explosion appears on contact with the enemy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41594160/bad1876629c3562c5e247482d7f3f66b5824efda.gif[/img]

That's all for now. 
🌴Thank you for your attention. 🌴

notes.title: Corsair`s Madness Prologue: Jungle`s Island RELEASE on 3.02
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43131581/ad38149604c7ee12a28b9683fc5fbdbd50e60608.png[/img]

Hey everyone, it's time to share the release date of the prologue. 

On [b]Friday[/b], [b]3.02[/b], you can finally try out an entire island to explore!
What awaits you as early as [b]TOMORROW[/b]:
[list]
[*] The story's plot
[*] 5 levels
[*] 3 bosses
[*] Playing as a character with two different combat systems
[*] Puzzle solving
[*] Boat battles
[*] Equipment upgrades
[/list]
